title: Onboarding recipe
description: What one kind of onboarding says and does, as data. Generated from OnboardingRecipe.ts in @slopus/happy-agent-modules; edit that file and regenerate rather than this one.

id.description: The recipe's name, reported as the flow's `recipe`.

version.description: The onboarding version this recipe completes. A newer version that adds a requirement returns a completed installation to onboarding for that requirement alone.

requirements.description: What completion proves, by the runtime's names, such as `provider` and `profile`.

bootstrap.description: The scripted opening, written by the server before any model is involved. A recipe without one hands the conversation to the model at once.

say.description: The opening: one message the server writes itself, before any model is involved, with `{{name}}` variables the runtime offers, HTML-escaped. It is never model input.

offer.description: Chat UI components the runtime puts below the opening's words, by type, each filled from the runtime's own state: `provider_sign_in` is one per AI the runtime can connect. With `replies`, they come one at a time instead: a tap on a reply answers with `answer` and the components for that reply's AI alone. A runtime refuses a type it cannot fill. The opening hands the conversation to the model once one of them connects an AI.

replies.description: Quick replies the runtime suggests below the opening's words in place of its components, by reply component type, each filled from the runtime's own state: `provider` is one reply per AI the runtime can connect, worded by its state ("Set up …", "Sign in to …", "Connect …"). The runtime answers a tap on one itself, with no model.

answer.description: Said when the person taps one of the opening's replies, with `{{provider}}` naming that reply's AI; the `offer` components for it alone follow.

failed.description: Said when the model's first turn after the hand-off ends without an answer, with `{{provider}}` and `{{reason}}`; the opening's components follow it again.

typing.description: `disabled`: the composer is disabled until the hand-off, and a typed message is refused. `handoff`: the composer stays enabled, and a typed message ends the opening at once and is answered by the model with the guide.

composerPlaceholder.description: The composer's placeholder while the opening waits, such as why it takes no typing.
The composer's placeholder while the guided part runs.

guide.description: The model's instructions while the guided part runs, with `{{name}}` variables as in `say`. Its hidden context entries are described here too. The model offers answers with `suggest_replies` and controls with `show_ui`, never with markup in its text.

tools.description: The tools at hand while the guided part runs, by the runtime's names: its onboarding tools, which exist only then, and tools it offers through tool search elsewhere, which are loaded then.
